spec.situation_desc: has a card payment they don't recognise

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Marcus speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I’ve got a card payment I don’t recognise, and I’m really unhappy that I’ve had to chase this.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve had that experience, and I’ll do what I can to help. Before we discuss your account, could you tell me your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, Carys. And could you confirm the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I’m sorry this has been frustrating. Can you tell me which payment you’re concerned about?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s £86.40 to BrightCart on the 19th of October. I’ve never used them.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I’ll log this as a complaint about the unrecognised payment and the service you’ve received. I can’t promise what the outcome will be.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Fine, but I don’t want it to just disappear into a queue.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I hear you. I’ll take ownership of the complaint and send it to our complaints team today. Someone will be in touch about the next steps, though I can’t give you a timescale for their review.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And what will you do personally?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll check that it’s been passed to the complaints team and call you by 3 pm tomorrow with an update on that. I can’t say what their decision will be.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. So you’re logging a complaint today, and you’ll call tomorrow to tell me it’s been passed on. The team will contact me about what happens next?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s right. I’ll call by 3 pm tomorrow with that update, and someone from the team will be in touch about next steps. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Carys. I’m sorry again for the trouble, and I’ll make sure I follow up tomorrow.
